messages:
Anna: Heads-up — customer's billing shows traffic being charged to our proxy project instead of their project when requests are proxied through edge-gateway. Repro attached.

Ben: Uh oh. Can you paste the minimal repro and any logs? Is it every request or intermittent?

Anna: Minimal curl below. Seems consistent for any path that uses the exchange. Edge replaces the Authorization header with a proxy token and the backend only sees the proxy identity.

```
# client
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer SK_cust_ABC" https://edge.redwood/v1/generate

# edge -> internal service
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer PK_edge_123" -H "X-RW-Origin: cust-ABC" https://svc.internal/predict
```

Anna: Quick suggestion: gateway emits a derived origin header (sha256(key_id)[:12]) or a short HMAC'd attestation token the backend can verify. Also add metrics: auth.proxy_attrib.miss_count and auth.proxy_attrib.sampled_traces. Dashboard: timeseries + top proxies table.

Olga: We need to be careful exposing original key ids in headers. Logs and any 3rd party infra could capture it. Prefer a derived id or signed subject token with minimal claims (org, project hash). Also document retention and masking policy.

Kevin: On implementation: we currently validate the proxy key then do quota charge. To attribute correctly we can either (A) resolve origin prior to charging (adds ~p50 latency), or (B) keep charge as-is but emit attribution events from gateway to billing pipeline asynchronously (eventual correctness). Both have tradeoffs.

Ben: Metric naming proposals: auth.proxy_attrib.miss_count (counter), auth.proxy_attrib.sample_rate (gauge), auth.proxy_attrib.sample_trace (histogram with label). Alert if miss_count / auth.total > 0.5% sustained for 10m. Dashboard should link to traces.

telemetry-bot: Metric lint OK — rule 'metric-conventions' passed: CI run 98123.

Olga: UX/rollout idea: console toggle per-org: "Preserve proxied origin for billing" (default off). Beta 1% orgs, subject to privacy review. When enabled, acceptance of origin header generates an audit event. Document fallback behavior for services that ignore header.

Anna: Action items: I'll open an RFC (design + API schema) proposing HMAC subject token format and header spec. @Ben please add metric skeleton + dashboard placeholder. @Olga prepare privacy & retention memo. @Kevin prototype pre-charge resolution vs event emission and measure latency/cost.

Kevin: Note for RFC: call out backward compatibility — older services ignoring header will see no change. Also consider a validation handshake where service returns a 1xx header to confirm it consumed attribution (maybe overkill).

Ben: I'll wire dashboard with a small panel: miss rate, top-10 proxy ids, and a sample traces table. Will add Pager duty alert if rate > 0.5% gap.

Olga: I'll run the privacy review and recommend the minimal derived id + masking. We should avoid anything that reveals org internal IDs verbatim.

Anna: Thanks — I'll ping billing/sales in RFC so they can verify reconciliation. Will post link when PR is up. :thumbsup:
